newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Koncar posts 14.7 mln kuna 1995 profit.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Koncar posts 14.7 mln kuna 1995 profit.

text.p: Croatia's electrical manufacturer group Koncar Elektroindustrija, possibly the next large firm to float its shares abroad and in which Germany's Siemens has a stake, posted a net profit of 14.7 million kuna in 1995.
According to results, published in weekly Privredni Vjesnik, pre-tax profit was 18.8 million kuna against 8.1 million kuna for the parent company.
There were no comparable figures for 1994 and company officials were not available for comment.
Koncar's 1995 figures were consolidated on the group level after the sale of stakes in some companies to foreign investors, including Siemens and Saudi Arabian Nesma Company Ltd.
The group had sales of 868 million kuna. It exports some 30 percent of total output.
But higher costs resulted in an operating loss for the group which was compensated by other income and extraordinary items, probably the sale of assets.
Koncar, in which the government still controls over 60 percent, said earlier this month its development plans included listing its shares on the Zagreb and London Stock Exchanges in about a year.
